transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling really down and sad for a very long time now, and it just doesn't seem to go away. It has been going on constantly for about two years and three months. I just feel persistently depressed almost every day.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, high, or irritable, and needed much less sleep than normal?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never had times where I felt unusually energetic, high, or needed less sleep.
During this period of over two years, have you ever had a stretch of two months or more where you felt completely normal and free of these symptoms?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. These feelings of sadness, emptiness, and feeling worthless have been constant and persistent throughout the entire two years and three months. I haven't felt completely free of them for even a two-month period.
Along with feeling down, have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels during this time?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels. They seem to have stayed pretty much the same throughout this time.
Have you had any trouble concentrating, making decisions, or felt a general sense of hopelessness during this time?

I struggle a lot with making decisions, and I constantly feel anxious and unsure about any choices I make. However, I haven't really noticed any specific trouble concentrating, and I don't feel a distinct sense of hopelessness.
How has your self-esteem or confidence been over these past two years? Do you often feel bad about yourself or feel like a failure?

My self-esteem and confidence have been incredibly low for the past two years and three months. I constantly criticize myself, feel completely worthless, and always feel inferior to everyone else. I also struggle to trust my own abilities and constantly doubt if I can do anything right.
You mentioned feeling constantly anxious. Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different everyday things, and do you find this worry very difficult to control?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about it that way. I mostly just feel anxious and unsure about my own decisions, rather than constantly worrying about everyday things.
Have you noticed a significant loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy doing?
I haven't really noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things specifically. I'm not really sure about that, to be honest.
